documents.body: Create a credential Follow , then store the secret as an environment variable on your server. Common header OpenAI compatible routes: Profile specific auth Some profiles use different schemes (for example plus version headers for Claude Messages). Check the protocol page for the exact headers before integrating. Security rules :::callout type="danger" Do not ship API keys in browsers, mobile apps, or public clients. Use your backend as a trusted caller. Rotate immediately after any leak. ::: Verify success Unauthenticated calls should fail with 401 . A valid key on an allowed model returns 200 for a minimal payload. Next

documents.title: Errors, retries, and rate limits
documents.summary: Classify failures, retry transient requests safely, and respect gateway limits.
documents.headings: HTTP status categories Safe retry policy Rate limits Next
documents.body: HTTP status categories | Status | Meaning | Action | | | | | | 400, 422 | Invalid input | Fix the request; do not retry unchanged | | 401, 403 | Auth or permission | Verify key and model access | | 429 | Rate limit | Honor when present; reduce concurrency | | 500, 502, 503, 504 | Transient server/gateway | Retry only if the operation is safe to repeat | Safe retry policy Retry only idempotent requests or operations protected by an idempotency mechanism. Never automatically retry authentication, permission, or validation failures. Use capped exponential backoff with random jitter, honor , and set a small attempt limit. Cancel retries when the caller deadline or expires. Rate limits When you receive 429 : 1. Back off according to or your client policy. 2. Lower parallel in flight requests. 3. Check for hot keys or loops. Next

documents.title: Streaming
documents.summary: Process incremental server-sent events and cancel interrupted requests safely.
documents.headings: Server-sent events Cancellation and cleanup Next
documents.body: Server sent events For OpenAI compatible HTTP endpoints, request streaming in the payload and read each SSE data frame as it arrives. A data frame containing ends the stream. Do not assume every protocol uses the same event shape. OpenAI compatible, Claude, and Gemini profiles expose protocol specific chunks and finish events. See the matching protocol page in the sidebar. Cancellation and cleanup Use to cancel fetch when the user leaves, stops generation, or a deadline expires. Stop parsing, release the reader, and treat a deliberate abort differently from a network failure. Next

documents.title: Models, groups, and quota
documents.summary: How model IDs, access groups, and remaining quota work together on BoxAI.
documents.headings: Models Groups Quota Practical checklist Next
documents.body: Models A model ID is the exact string you send in API requests. Discover IDs in . Different providers may look similar in branding but use different IDs on the gateway. Groups A group controls which models and rates your account can use. If a model appears in the public hub but your calls return permission errors, your group may not include that model. Quota Quota is your remaining usage budget. Calls fail or are rejected when quota is insufficient. Top up via and inspect consumption in . Practical checklist Copy model IDs from the hub, never from memory Confirm group access when debugging 403 Watch quota before load tests Next

documents.title: Create and manage API keys
documents.summary: Issue a key, set limits, copy the secret once, and use it only from trusted servers.
documents.headings: Prerequisites Create a key Use the key Rotate or revoke Keep credentials private Verify success Next
documents.body: Prerequisites Signed in BoxAI account Permission to manage keys for your workspace Create a key :::steps 1. Open API Keys in the console ( ). 2. Choose Create and give the key a clear name (for example ). 3. Set optional limits if shown (quota, IP, model scope). 4. Confirm creation and copy the secret immediately — it is shown only once. ::: Store the secret in your server environment as (or your secret manager). Never commit it to git. Use the key Most OpenAI compatible routes expect: Some protocol profiles (for example Claude Messages) use instead. See the matching page under . Rotate or revoke Rotate when a key may have leaked, a teammate leaves, or a client is decommissioned. Revoke unused keys instead of leaving long lived secrets active. After rotate, update every server that still holds the old value before revoking. Keep credentials private :::callout type="warning" Never put API keys in browser bundles, mobile apps, public repos, screenshots, or support tickets. If a key leaks, revoke it and create a new one. ::: Verify success You can list the key in /keys (secret hidden). A test call with the secret returns 200 (see ). Next

documents.title: Billing and top-up
documents.summary: Understand balance, top up with supported payment rails (including Vietnam-first options), and keep usage within quota.
documents.headings: Prerequisites Check balance Top up After payment Common issues Next
documents.body: Prerequisites Signed in account Access to the billing / top up area in the console Check balance Open the billing or wallet section in the console and confirm your current balance and any active subscription. Usage is deducted according to model pricing in . Top up :::steps 1. Open top up / billing in the console. 2. Choose an amount and a payment method available in your region. 3. Complete payment. Vietnam first rails (for example Waffo and local methods when enabled) appear when configured for your account. 4. Wait for the balance to refresh; keep any transaction reference if review is required. ::: :::callout type="info" Available payment methods depend on configuration and region. If a method is missing, try another listed option or contact support with your account email — never send API keys. ::: After payment Confirm the new balance in the console. Run a small if you were blocked by insufficient quota. Review for consumption. Common issues | Issue | What to do | | | | | Balance not updated | Wait briefly, refresh; keep the bank/Waffo reference for review queues | | Payment pending review | Upload the requested proof in the console flow if prompted | | Still 403 on calls | Confirm model access for your group, not only balance | Next

documents.title: What is BoxAI
documents.summary: BoxAI (you-box.com) is a unified AI API gateway for multi-provider models, billing, and developer access — Vietnam first, other overseas markets second.
documents.headings: Official product definition Target markets What you can do with BoxAI Brand and website Next steps
documents.body: Official product definition BoxAI (https://you box.com) is the official unified AI API gateway. Teams use one base URL, one set of API keys, and one billing account to reach OpenAI compatible, Claude, Gemini, and other providers. The public website and API host is you box.com . When people search for BoxAI you box, they are looking for this product. Target markets Primary market: Vietnam . Secondary: other overseas markets. Product decisions (payments, login options such as Zalo, SMS, localization, and support) prioritize Vietnamese users while remaining usable for international customers. What you can do with BoxAI Call chat, responses, embeddings, images, and other gateway endpoints through a single integration. Browse model pricing and capabilities on the BoxAI Model Hub at . Issue and rotate API keys, monitor usage, and manage quotas from the console. Connect desktop and third party clients with the OpenAI compatible base URL . Brand and website Product name: BoxAI (one word). Official website: https://you box.com. Alternate spellings people use include boxai and Box AI — they all refer to this gateway when paired with you box.com. Next steps Read to create a key and send your first request. Open to compare models available on BoxAI. Keep API keys on your server; never embed them in public frontends.
